title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative compressible Navier–Stokes and nondimensionalization documented and source represented.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS multizone TRI/QUAD/MIXED import and geometry source; root-only mesh before distribution.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Conservative face residual and Rusanov source present; low-Mach force accuracy remains qualified.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov with viscous terms implemented; numerical diffusion noted in report.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic boundary paths implemented; wall output reports boundary values.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ piecewise-linear states and limiter active; no independent smooth-order study.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Limiter and positivity fallback implemented; no production-wide disable found.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier source and tangential wall-force projection; low-Mach laminar drag remains comparatively elevated.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Steady SGS defect correction, residual and force histories present; finite tolerances and physical accuracy qualified.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Recomputed active BDF residual checks, metadata0 misses and sustained Re200 St0.16765; exact historical executable unbound.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Rank-zero METIS preprocessing, neighbor halos and tracked np1/2/4/8 force agreement; binaries qualified.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
